coverageMeaning.openExpression: Three prompts and human review checklists; no automatic competency or score claim.
coverageMeaning.novelty: Distinct contexts do not imply distinct structures. The banks rehearse constrained basic expressions; NCE1-7 intentionally repeats No, I am not under different explicit facts.
